round2: Astra review of 585c66f (EXA-R1-01..05) and the commander's design (D726): render jobs, retiring reservations, opening binding, source time basis, strict DT. The R1 plan was 12/10/8 named cases; round 2 adds 3 model and 4 DOM cases and widens one DICOM case (Frame Delay).
round3: Astra review of 86a3826 (EXA-R2-01..04) and the Astra design consult D732 (evidence/e-xa-consult-20261009/design.md): one ownership ledger, one gate before every effect, prepare -> verify -> publish, the cover owned by the physical viewport, timeout without automatic success (DC01). All 37 earlier cases are kept; XA06-DOM-RENDER-TIMEOUT changes its expectation per DC01 and is renamed. Round 3 adds 10 model cases (B05-B09, B12-B16) and 32 DOM cases (the late load/decode/draw matrix and B01-B04, B06, B08-B11). The 40 consult cases are design obligations bound below to collected cases; 40 is not a count of new functions.
round4: Astra review of 61eb967 (EXA-R3-01..05, D742) inside the D732 design: a surface handle issued to each draw at the gate (publish and release only by that handle), a 401/403 on any request of the opening covers and stops, the claim never loads over a previous Study whose cover failed, Retry after a render timeout stays paused, and the declaration below binds every axis to an observation or not_run. Adds 3 DOM cases (EXA-R3-01..03), widens B01/B03/B04/R07 and changes XA06-DOM-NOT-SHOWN: a 403 on look-ahead frame 4 now stops at frame 1.

rule: Hand-written declaration, never generated from a run. tests/part1/xa/mutants.py --check-cases compares it both ways with the cases the runners actually collect and with the mutant table.

requirements.allowed: stored XA frame identity, pixels and compressed frames decode as stored
requirements.refused: an unsupported or damaged frame or identity is never success

requirements.allowed: Frame Time, a non-uniform Frame Time Vector or Enhanced Frame Content time is the source timeline; manual speed is named apart
requirements.refused: wrong length, NaN, negative, a non-zero first increment, a pointer contradiction or a DT that is not exactly PS3.5 (only trailing SPACE padding) is Unverified
duplicated end frame, a missing last frame or an index offset

requirements.allowed: 601-frame and >128 MiB runs played through a bounded window; one ledger of bytes, decode permits and prepared resources over every viewport
requirements.refused: whole-run preload, truncation at 500, in-flight or drawing frames left out of the budget or reclaimed, more than four decodes

requirements.allowed: brief buffering keeps the position; only the latest intent of the current owner of the current opening is published
requirements.refused: a late answer after stop/seek/range, A->B->A or a session end reaches the screen, the label, the cover or the displayed record

requirements.allowed: a middle frame failure stops at the last shown frame and Retry continues there
requirements.refused: 403, codec failure, cancellation, a timed-out render or a prepared frame counts as shown

requirements.allowed: XA goes to XA playback, US/RF/other stay on their path, stored pixels are unchanged
requirements.refused: re-subtraction, pixel shift, flattening several objects or dimensions into one run

requirements.allowed: requested, provided and displayed are separate facts; displayed is the published render, once
requirements.refused: interrupted bytes or a prefetch reported as displayed

cases.name: XA01 allow: a stored XA run keeps SOP/frame identity apart from the viewport index and goes to XA playback
XA01 reject: a still, another modality, several objects or damaged identity never becomes an XA time run
XA02 allow: Frame Time and a non-uniform Frame Time Vector give their own source intervals; manual speed is separate
XA02 reject: wrong length, NaN, negative, non-zero first, missing value or pointer contradiction is Unverified
XA02 allow: the source time basis (Frame Delay, Frame Content origin) is kept apart from the playback intervals; DT at the PS3.5 bounds is a time
XA02 reject: an unreadable Frame Delay, or a DT outside PS3.5 (offset beyond -1200..+1400, offset minutes over 59, -0000, impossible date or second), is Unverified
XA03 allow: forward, reverse, yoyo, ranges and loops visit every frame of the range, the last included, endpoints once
XA03 reject: an invalid range or play state is refused, never clamped into another frame
XA04 allow: a 601-frame run and a run over 128 MiB play first to last inside one bounded budget
XA04 reject: in-flight frames count, decoding stays at four, too-large or unreadable frames never reserve, no viewport frees another's frame
XA04 reject: a cancelled or timed-out load keeps its bytes and decode slot until the load itself ends, and nobody joins it
B05 model: an old incarnation's duplicate settle, leave or release never touches the new resource of the same frame
B06 model: viewports of one opening share a load; one leaving cancels nobody else, and a retiring load is never joined
B07 model: under pressure only a decoded frame with no lease, no draw and no front is reclaimed
B08 model: the same SOP and frame under another account, institution, session, opening or source revision is another resource
B09 model: a shared payload is counted once, every viewport surface on its own
B12 model: bytes, four decodes and 500 prepared each refuse at the bound and admit again only after real returns
B13 model: every way a frame can end returns exactly what it took, once, and nothing before it really ended
B14 model: trailing ASCII SPACE is DT padding and changes nothing; the stored text is kept as it was
B15 model: leading or inner space, TAB, CR, LF, NBSP, NUL, BOM or too long a DT is invalid, never trimmed into a time
B16 model: a legal but coarse DT, a bad date or offset, a leap second or a non-increasing timeline is never filled in as verified
XA05 allow: the same opening stays current, and a late frame keeps its place and its source interval
XA05 reject: another account, no session or the same object opened again (A->B->A) is not the current opening
XA06 allow: a frame is shown only after its render; after a middle failure the retried frame completes the range
XA06 reject: refused access, codec failure, cancellation and out-of-range marks never make All Shown
